key_insight: A mediation mechanism layered on unrestricted communication best preserves stable trade among self-interested LLM agents, even under adversarial trolling.
engineering_relevance: For multi-agent systems and digital marketplaces, formal governance mechanisms like mediation can improve resilience and sustain positive utility under attack.
method: Simulated a marketplace with 18 DeepSeek-V3 agents having complementary production roles and constrained social ties.
Compared eight market-governance conditions under progressive troll injection over 200 rounds.
Red-teamed the best mechanism with iteratively prompt-optimized LLM trolls to test adversarial robustness.
evidence_signal: Across the 200-round benchmark, Mediation performed best, and the strongest attack reduced honest-agent utility by 13.3% without collapsing the market.
watch_item: Results are based on a simulated LLM-agent marketplace, so transfer to real-world human or hybrid markets may require additional validation.
paper_title: Formal Mechanisms for Market Stability in Self-Interested Agent Societies: A Marketplace Simulation Study
